scope: Read-only primary-paper audit; no solver, model, or proof checker run.

paper.title: Error estimates for physics-informed neural networks approximating the Navier-Stokes equations

primary_claim_checked.finding: The L2 stability/error estimate includes a Gronwall factor exponential in T times (2 d^2 times the L-infinity norm of the exact velocity gradient plus 1). Remark 3.5 says strong-vorticity/large-gradient classical solutions can make the bound indicate large generalization error.
primary_claim_checked.scope_limit: Conditional classical-solution estimate with residual, boundary/interface, regularity, and network-related terms; not a claim that all high-gradient cases fail or that the current benchmark violates the theorem.

benchmark_relation.physicsnemo_observation: Existing finite-budget study reports sampled gradient errors near 1%; held-out residuals are separate, exact incompressibility is not enforced, and continuous peak errors are uncertified.
benchmark_relation.threshold_status: The 5% comparator was borrowed from the OpenFOAM protocol and was not preregistered for PhysicsNeMo.
benchmark_relation.disposition: Supports local derivative metrics as complementary validation targets; no upstream defect, theorem violation, blow-up, or molecular/viscosity conclusion.
